headline: Hamden Middle School field replacement and Rochford field contract, plus league stipends and summer camp fees, are on the agenda.
summary: Items include league stipends, with a status update and a question about what leagues should provide in 2027. An ice rink committee update and the 2027 meeting schedule are also listed.
